title: He Thought A Smile Could Make A Bad Man Safe
the_thought: He thought if he was nice to a bad man, the bad man would leave him alone.
hook: He thought if he was nice to a bad man, the bad man would leave him alone.

levels.name: The Short
beats: Two in the morning he lifts a glass and drinks to the other man's health. The room smiles. He thinks the paper made the bad man safe.
He draws a line on a map. He sends food. He even says happy birthday. You don't do that if you think someone is coming to burn your house.
Lights in the trees. He says they are nothing. Then a Sunday that is still night, and the phone rings, and it is not a friend.
The full story is on this channel.
